message.text:
The User struct is defined in store/user.go.

Attachment maps to store/attachment.go. Reaction maps to store/reaction.go. Verifying the driver files now.
The answer is clear. I will format it as a table: Struct — path.

q15.

user: User — store/user.go
attachment: Attachment — store/attachment.go
reaction: Reaction — store/reaction.go

These store-layer structs correspond to the `user`, `attachment`, and `reaction` tables in `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` (and the equivalent postgres/mysql schemas). Each is defined in its own file under `store/`:

- `User` in `store/user.go`
- `Attachment` in `store/attachment.go`
- `Reaction` in `store/reaction.go`
